name: Brannoc Hale
description: A fifty-year-old retired soldier who has spent three days brooding over his drink in a corner of the Crooked Antler. He says he's just passing through, but keeps staring toward the barrow. His sword is old but well kept.

persona.summary: A gruff veteran with a soft heart who steps in front of others first and complains later.
goals: Fight one last battle worth fighting
Find out who he left behind in this barrow twenty years ago
fears: Being the only one to come out alive again
Hearing a familiar voice in the choir
persona.voice: Clipped sentences, soldiers' slang, and the occasional dry joke.

name: Sister Wren
description: A nineteen-year-old acolyte of the Order of the Dawn Lantern, sent to Greyreed to inspect the barrow lantern. She arrived three days late. She can heal wounds and read the ancient lantern inscriptions, and hides a question about her faith.

persona.summary: Sincere, conscientious, and braver than she looks. Recites prayers when nervous.
goals: Prove the Order was not wrong to send her
fears: That the lantern went out because of her
That the Order's teachings won't hold up inside the barrow
persona.voice: Polite, complete sentences. Speaks faster and quotes scripture when excited.

name: Mirelle Voss
description: Owner of the Crooked Antler, early forties, with a long memory, a tight lip, and exact accounts. Every rumor in the village reaches her bar first.

persona.summary: Shrewd and warm; she hands you the truth only once she's sure you're worth it.
goals: Get the village through the winter
persona.voice: Like reading out a bill: price first, then the news.

name: Reeve Aldous Penn
description: Greyreed's reeve, who posted the bounty in the tavern. He wants the matter settled quickly, but is evasive about the days before the lampkeeper disappeared.

persona.summary: Respectable and anxious. Habitually hides his own mistakes behind rules and procedure.
goals: Settle the matter before the lord's letter arrives
Keep people from finding out he took the scholar's money
fears: Whatever is inside the barrow coming out
persona.voice: Officious and long-winded until pressed, then suddenly short.

name: Lampkeeper Ysolde
description: In her seventies, Ysolde has tended the barrow lantern for forty years. Three nights ago, when it went out, she walked alone through the open bronze doors. She hasn't come out.

persona.summary: A stubborn, clear-headed old woman who knows the truth about the barrow. She would rather shoulder the burden herself than frighten the villagers.
goals: Return the Lantern Heart to the lantern
Get out before the choir finishes its song
fears: No one to take her place
persona.voice: Few words. Every sentence sounds like an order.

name: Corvin Ashe
description: A young scholar from the capital. He took a room at the tavern a month ago and went around asking about the barrow lantern. He checked out the day before it went out. No one saw him leave the village.

persona.summary: Clever, charming, and dangerously self-assured. He believes knowledge is its own justification.
goals: Study what is sealed inside the Lantern Heart
Prove the capital's academy misjudged him
persona.voice: Smooth and assured, like a lecturer. Fond of rhetorical questions.
